note: City of Adel park on the North Raccoon River, 2400 Nantucket Rd. Large back-in sites plus a few pull-throughs, modern shower house, dump station with rinse hose. Campers in 2025-26 describe first-come sites: pick a space, pay by envelope; call to confirm. Soccer fields beside the loop; rail-trail access nearby. --Claude
